newsitem.title: USA: American Industrial to merge real estate LPs.
newsitem.headline: American Industrial to merge real estate LPs.

text.p: American Industrial Properties REIT said Tuesday that it had signed a pact for the merger of four real estate limited partnerships into the trust.
The four real estate limited partnerships are USAA Real Estate Income Investments I LP, USAA Real Estate Income Investments II LP, USAA Income Properties III LP and USAA Income Properties IV LP.
Each is affiliated with USAA Real Estate Co, which owns 31.8 percent of the outstanding shares of American Industrial.

The partnerships own 11 properties with an aggregate of 1,601,000 square feet. They include office, industrial and retail properties, and the net book value of real estate held by the partnershops at March 31 was about $105 million, American Industrial said.
The agreement is subject to negotiation of financial terms, obtaining fairness opinions, completion of definitive merger pacts and other terms and requirements.
Accordingly, there can be no assurance that definitive merger agreements will be reached or that the mergers will be ultimately consummated, the company said in a statement.
It said however that if all proceeded as planned, shareholder and limited partner meetings would be held in the fourth quarter to vote on the merger agreement.
